description: Resonator: a bank of tuned filters, sympathetic strings or plucked string models, excited by an audio input or by a burst it generates itself

params.text: Cycles the number of overlapping voices between one, two and four, so notes played in sequence can ring on over each other
Cycles the resonator between modal, sympathetic strings and modulated string
Sets the pitch over five octaves; while V/OCT is patched it snaps to semitones
Sets the frequency ratios between the partials of the modal resonator, the tuning of the sympathetic strings, or the amount of detuning and modulation of the string resonator
Sets the level of the higher harmonics, low settings giving wood or nylon and high settings glass or steel
Sets how long a note rings, from under 100ms to about 10 seconds
Sets where the excitation strikes the string or surface; in the middle the even harmonics cancel and the tone goes hollow
Attenuverts the frequency input; with nothing patched there that input reads a constant 1V, so the knob works as a fine tuning control

inputs.text: Modulates the brightness through its attenuverter
Shifts the pitch through its attenuverter, on an exponential scale that stays gentle near the centre
Modulates the damping through its attenuverter
Modulates the structure through its attenuverter
Modulates the excitation position through its attenuverter
A voltage of 1V or more lets the sounding voice decay and starts the next one; with nothing patched here a note change on V/OCT does that, or a transient in the audio input if V/OCT is empty
Sets the pitch of the resonator, one volt per octave
The audio that excites the resonator; with nothing patched here a pulse or burst of noise is generated at each strum

outputs.text: The odd-numbered partials or strings, or one of two complementary components of a single voice; with only one of the two outputs patched, it carries the whole signal
The even-numbered partials or strings, or one of two complementary components of a single voice; with only one of the two outputs patched, it carries the whole signal

notes: the resonator makes no sound until something strums it, and with none of STRUM, V/OCT or the audio input patched nothing ever does.
with STRUM unpatched, a strum is taken from a note change on V/OCT, or from a transient in the audio input when V/OCT is unpatched as well.
the module is monophonic: on a polyphonic cable only the first channel is read.
menu: Resonator — picks the model: Modal resonator, Sympathetic strings, Modulated/inharmonic string, FM voice, Quantized sympathetic strings or Reverb string
Disastrous Peace — swaps the resonator for the four-voice string synthesizer hidden in the hardware, with chorus, reverb and formant effects
